# Anne Shirley & Priscilla Grant

The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P58](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0058), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), +1 more</sub>

## Shared scenes

> After being punished by Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) and forced to sit next to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md) decides to leave school permanently. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) seeks advice from Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), who suggests letting [Anne](../character/anne.md) stay home until she cools down. Later, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) finds [Anne](../character/anne.md) weeping over imaginary future sorrow about [Diana](../character/diana.md) getting married, which sends [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) into a rare fit of laughter.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) adjusts to life at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), forming close friendships with [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) while continuing her intense academic rivalry with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). She enjoys weekend visits home to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) during the autumn and spends spare time visiting [Miss Barry](../character/miss-barry.md) at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood). As spring arrives and final exams loom, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and her friends gather to discuss their anxieties, upcoming commencement clothes, and hopes for the future.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s

> Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) expresses skepticism about the [American](../codex/factions.md#american)-raised [Irving](../character/irving.md) boy coming to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and warns [Anne](../character/anne.md) against establishing a Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society). [Anne](../character/anne.md) defends her plans to improve Avonlea's appearance alongside [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). Finally, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) shares the news that Anne's former classmate, [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), has been hired to teach at [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) school.
>
> — v2 · I An Irate Neighbor

> [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), and Jane plead with [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) not to rent his fences for patent medicine ads, but he refuses. Later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally overhears Judson taking a political bribe from [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry.md) near the Lake of [Shining Waters](../codex/places.md#shining-waters). Fearing [Anne](../character/anne.md) will expose his corruption and ruin his reputation, Judson agrees to cancel the ad deal to keep her quiet, though [Anne](../character/anne.md) refuses to make a deal and simply keeps the secret out of principle.
>
> — v2 · XIV A Danger Averted

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) departs [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with [Dora](../character/dora.md), leaving [Anne](../character/anne.md) to do household chores while [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) goes to help Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). While transferring bed feathers, [Anne](../character/anne.md) mistakenly applies rug dye to her nose instead of freckle lotion, turning it bright red just before [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) arrives with famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md). [Diana](../character/diana.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne.md) wash off the dye and supplies a roast chicken, allowing [Anne](../character/anne.md) to successfully entertain her visitors with a lovely dinner and a walk through the surrounding woods.
>
> — v2 · XX The Way It Often Happens
